items.title: Mobile applications
items.body: React Native and Expo for iOS and Android — marketplaces, field tools, and consumer apps with Supabase or custom backends.

items.title: Web platforms
items.body: Astro and React sites, dashboards, and internal portals — performance, SEO, and conversion-focused architecture.

items.title: IoT & embedded
items.body: ESP8266/32 telemetry, ultrasonic sensing, and MQTT ingest — the same patterns behind traffic monitoring and tank-level prototypes.

items.title: Cloud & backend
items.body: PostgreSQL, serverless APIs, and Cloudflare Pages Functions that keep clients thin and business rules server-side.

items.title: Systems engineering
items.body: SCADA-aware specs, energy monitoring design, and BOQ-grade documentation from an electrical engineering background.

why.label: Why VersaCarte
why.title: One team from schematic to App Store review
why.body: Clients get firmware, API, and mobile UI under one roof — not three vendors who hand off blame. We design for intermittent power, mobile money, and mid-range devices common in East Africa.
